text: The 879 fetch callback broadens its save gate to a token change or a scope change. The current _fetchAccessToken keeps that condition, awaits setRefreshToken, then updates _scope. This matters when a server grants different scopes while retaining the refresh token. The initial 870 subset diagnostic was reversed and 878 fixes its wording and the empty preference fallback. Current provider details and wanted-versus-required scopes have changed again, so the old preference fallback is historical rather than the current configuration recipe. Manual diagnostic proposal: state which set contains which other set and use distinct granted, required and stored scope names. Reuse the existing caller-gate lesson; this landing supplies the concrete repair.
title: Scope changes must reach the persistence helper even when the token string is unchanged
